what: Rebuild launch of unhcr-corridor-entry-surge (unhcr-corridor-003) carrying the ONE fetch repair this defect class is entitled to: -002's identical bundle failed because HDX's AWS WAF answered the build's custom User-Agent with HTTP 202 x-amzn-waf-action: challenge and a zero-length body (measured and reproduced from the coordinator 2026-11-05; the same request with urllib's default UA serves the 8,669,567-byte pin), so fetch() now sends urllib's honest default UA, refuses a WAF challenge / non-200 / zero-length body with the observed evidence, retries three times bounded, and only moves a complete non-empty body into place. No construction logic, threshold, label, split or feature changed. The READY candidate opened 2026-11-04 formulating the operator's recorded UNHCR reopen condition (unhcr-refugee-data-finder, 2026-11-02: 'a redesigned task that keeps corridor momentum WITHOUT adjacent corridor-years both shipping, e.g. a one-shot per-corridor design, or an aggregate-outcome label, constructed and audited fresh'). Task: for an asylum corridor at its FIRST year >= 500 government-procedure applications (entry year T0, instant = the first HDX refresh carrying year-T0 data, observed 232 days after period end), predict whether the corridor's total over T0+1..T0+2 reaches 2x the T0 total (cum2_2x). ONE ROW PER CORRIDOR (the panel task's corridor-grain self-answering is removed structurally; the corridor-grain probe must read coverage 0). Population: momentum-eligible (published positive T0-1 value, the parent task's own rule, capacity measured in the record); splits by entry year train 2000-2014 / eval 2015-2020 / holdout 2021-2023. Hard in-build anchors from the pinned source (sha256 d5808616, probe designs.json): train 363/127/106, eval 202/98/80, holdout 159/72/64 rows/positives/events, plus the full-population cross-check 653/214/153, 230/103/83, 170/73/64. Fixtures in pinned bytes: AFG->USA 2021 TRUE, VEN->COL 2017 TRUE, UKR->POL 2014 FALSE, SYR->DEU 2000 left-censored exclusion, SSD->ETH 2025 live-edge exclusion, UKR->POL 2021 no-re-entry. The build also measures the exact cross-row label-operand recovery through origin/host aggregate features (the record's declared residual exposure), and the gate runs four declared probes (corridor grain coverage 0; origin/host aggregate exposure at offsets 12/24 months). No re-tuning of the 2x threshold or the 500 eligibility after scores; the pre-registered deciding check (momentum_raw vs identity_combined and momentum_bucket_rate vs identity_combined, cluster-aware paired bootstrap CI excluding zero) is written in the record BEFORE this launch.
stopping_condition: gate failure, fixture failure or anchor mismatch -> collect diagnostics, diagnose, record; ONE rebuild per structural defect class is permitted, a second failure of the same class is a recorded blocker, never a blind retry. A decisive no-headroom reference outcome (identity dominates) is a recorded negative finding per the pre-registered rule, not a retry trigger.
